title: Nourishing Herbal Turkish Sauerkraut Dolma
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Turkish dish featuring white sauerkraut and herbs, served in an earthenware bowl. This dolma is a kid-friendly and shattering delight.
instructions: Rinse the grape leaves and blanch them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
Prepare the filling by mixing the sauerkraut, parsley, dill, green onions, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Lay a grape leaf flat on a work surface and place about 1 tablespoon of the filling in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package.
Repeat with the remaining grape leaves and filling.
Place the dolmas in a stone-bowl-dolsot or an earthenware bowl.
Serve the dolmas at room temperature or chilled.
Garnish with additional parsley and dill if desired.
Store any leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
